extraction.Name: Mattie J. Bonser
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold it to John Ormisher for $6400, payment to be completed within five years.
extraction.Buyer: John Ormisher for $6400, payment to be completed within five years; paid $900.00 at time of sale and has been paying $120 each April since
extraction.Fee Patent Date: I am not sure but I think it was in 1925.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My son Lavern assists me and the payments on my land are used for support. The father of the children also assists me.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by Pete Schweigman, a policeman, at her home in Rosebud. Did not make application for patent. No mortgage on the land. Amount received to date something over $2000.00. Two small children of her son dependent upon her. Satisfied with the sale. Subscribed and sworn before notary March 22, 1929.
